camel_example: aliyun drds ModifyPolarDbReadWeight --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --Weights '14,86' --DbNodeIds 'pi-0000000000000000,pi-0000000000000000:pi-0000000000000000' --DbName test --DbInstanceId 'pc-0000000000000000'
description_en: Modifies the read and write weights of a PolarDB cluster by calling the ModifyPolarDbReadWeight operation
description_zh: 调用ModifyPolarDbReadWeight接口修改PolarDB的读写权重
kebab_example: aliyun drds modify-polar-db-read-weight --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --db-name test --db-node-ids pi-0000000000000000,pi-0000000000000000:pi-0000000000000000 --db-instance-id pc-0000000000000000 --weights 14,86 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPolarDbReadWeight

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of nodes in the target PolarDB cluster. Nodes from different clusters are separated by commas (,), and nodes within the same cluster are separated by colons (:)
parameters.help_zh: 目标PolarDB集群下对应的节点列表，不同集群的节点间用英文逗号（,）分组，组内节点用英文冒号（:）隔开
parameters.name: db_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarDB cluster
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The weights corresponding to PolarDB groups. Separate multiple weights with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: PolarDB分组对应的权重，多个权重间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: weights
